name: nox-soft-contacts
title: Essentials Series - surface footsteps
author: Nox_Sound_Design
approval: 2026-10-18: owner approved the softened six-contact dirt/grass auditions for use, acceptable but not perfect, and subsequently requested footwear-dependent footsteps and more pack variations for each surface. Expanded selections are numerically validated, not approved by listening; source footwear is unspecified.
selectionNotes: Separate walk, run and landing source banks; crouching may reuse walking contacts. The first six dirt and grass walking sources are preserved exactly.
Only actual contact recordings are selected. Jump_Start, Grass/Foley_Grass, Iceland recordings and Water_Jump_Big are excluded.
Use normal Snow, MetalV1 and WaterV1 walking for consistent surface families; Snow_Hard, MetalV2 and WaterV2 are excluded.
Rock landing 03 is the only selected rock landing: 01, 02, 04, 05 and 06 contain full-scale samples and are excluded.

Selected files were checked as finite, nonempty, nonsilent 48 kHz mono PCM24 audio without full-scale samples. Per-file SHA-256 records original extracted bytes; no trimming or processing is represented here.
Raw source levels differ substantially between surfaces and gaits; the build recipe must calibrate them while retaining the approved softened dirt/grass character.
